changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingwallet AS SELECT bw.id, bw.patient_id, bw.currency, bw.credited_amount, bw.available_balance, bw.reserved_balance, bw.consumed_amount, bw.refunded_amount, bw.status, bw.created_by, bw.created_date, bw.last_modified_by, bw.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_wallet bw;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingwallet TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingwallet FROM report_user;
